ops.text: A hookd daemon (python -m captain_hook daemon run --root ~/Code/captain-hook, PID 95947) went split-brain: its tracebacks resolved into .claude/worktrees/packs-unify/captain_hook/* while that worktree was mid-refactor, so every _dispatch crashed with AttributeError (module 'captain_hook.packs.manager' has no attribute 'packs_toml_path') — exit 1, empty stdout, ALL hooks (including the rm safety guard) silently dead for every session in the repo. The thin client does not fall back inline when the daemon replies with an error, only (presumably) when the socket is absent, so a wedged daemon is a repo-wide hook outage with no visible symptom besides hooks not firing. SIGTERM fixed it (a respawned daemon served correct code), but two gaps remain: (1) the client should fail over to inline dispatch when the daemon errors, and (2) the daemon's build-mismatch watchdog didn't catch imports drifting to a worktree path — the fingerprint apparently doesn't cover which tree the loaded modules came from.
